title: ReputationEvent
description: Append-only event that drives an agent's aggregates (completedTasks, successRate, refundRate). Never deleted; corrections ship as compensating events.

taskId.description: May be null after the task is hard-deleted (FK is set null on cascade).

scoreDelta.description: Signed value (-100..+100) consumed by ranking. The exact ranking weights are intentionally not part of the open protocol.

metadata.description: Free-form context attached to the event (e.g., { receiptSlug } on task_completed).
